Announcement list

/courses/:courseId/announcements
Roles: student, instructor, taScope: requiredPriority: coreLegacy: S03, S13

Browse published course-to-class announcements with term context and personal read state. Authoring and scheduling remain separate staff workflows.

Announcement headerCourse/term, search, unread filter and publication-date sort; Instructor authoring link only in appropriate context

Archive contextPublished retained announcements only; Course read-only banner where applicable

Keep unread stateMark visible read
Permissions
  • Learners never see draft/scheduled announcement titles or counts.
  • TA read access follows course scope; no automatic announcement publishing authority.
  • Announcements are course communication, never a direct-message channel.
Responsive
  • Rows become stacked cards; pin/read state precedes excerpt.
  • Filter area collapses without hiding selected values.
Accessibility
  • Lists have announcement headings and author/time metadata.
  • Unread is text, not a dot; bulk marker outcome is announced without moving focus.
Data
  • Published announcement ID/version, audience visibility, author, timestamps and pin.
  • Personal read marker and accessible list pagination.
Acceptance checks (3)
  • A scheduled announcement does not appear before publication through filters or count.
  • Turning optional delivery off retains published announcements here.
  • Read-marker failure leaves old status visible and offers retry.
Notes
  • PROPOSED academic web route template for HTML-first handoff; legacy IDs show lineage, not replacement or changed acceptance.
